scope: Authenticated source contract for native Python reference objects

rangeRef.get_tuple: Active zero-argument method returning two new CellRef wrapper objects, not a tuple of scalar coordinates.
rangeRef.returnConversion: Accepted only for actual native RangeRef object type; retains raw GnmRangeRef endpoints.

cellRef.sheet: Actual referenced sheet object or Python None for an implicit current sheet.
cellRef.get_tuple: Not implemented: method entry is commented out in released source.
cellRef.returnConversion: No CellRef branch in py_obj_to_gnm_value; standalone CellRef is not an accepted range result.

portableFinding: Current cooperative runtime references are normalized invocation-owned sheet/coordinate ranges. They omit native raw signed offsets, endpoint relativity and wrapper semantics. This is an open source-language port boundary, not a request to add nonexistent CellRef.get_tuple parity.
remaining: Actual native loader invocation with original raw absolute/relative/implicit-sheet/cross-sheet probes.
